config.scope: OFFLINE SOURCE DEVELOPMENT diagnostic only; no alignment/prediction/model fit, no E04 or calibrated/live efficacy claim
config.extraction: Untreated raw cached covariance features[N,8times,19bins,7states,9coordinates]: LAST time,current state0; no fitted normalization
config.covariance_coordinates: 3real diagonals, sqrt2*real(01,02,12), sqrt2*imag(01,02,12); inverse uses /sqrt2 and exact Hermitian lower triangle
config.endpoints: Use actual quality-retained canonical39:8:296 endpoints. Never resurrect rejected histories or the allocated tail
config.precision: Cached covariance coordinates are float32, decoded float64/complex128; reject newly nonpositive or condition>1e10 states, no I jitter
config.rf_distance: sqrt(mean_over19bins(sum_over3(log generalized eigenvalues squared))); first arm uses existing determinant normalization/paired shrinkage/centered spectrum, second raw SPD eigenvalues without normalization/shrinkage
config.teacher_distance: Euclidean RMS over34 hip-root-relative coordinate differences, from supplied 2D annotations; teacher labels used ONLY for diagnostic scoring
config.correlation: Upper triangle excluding diagonal. Raw Spearman=Pearson of average ranks. Residual=Pearson after independently subtracting each exact endpoint-time-lag group's mean from both global rank vectors
config.clock_control: Report Spearman of actual endpoint lag vs RF distance and vs teacher distance. Time/record/action IDs are score/control metadata, never model features
config.circular_null: Every1..n-1 circular RF-index shift permutes BOTH distance axes against fixed teachers/times; preserves observed-index RF autocorrelation, not exact physical-time autocorrelation when endpoints are missing
config.null_quantile: 95th percentile of finite residual correlations, NumPy linear method; all null vectors retained; descriptive, not an independence-based pvalue
config.gate: PER ARM: fixedA12 residual>=.3 AND aligned-minus95th-null>=.1; all90record residuals defined, median>=.1 and at least60positive. Missing/degenerate records prevent continuation; no best-arm-per-record pooling
config.limits: Repeated participants/actions, correlated pair distances, source-only post-motivation protocol. Fixed receiver-mixing assumption unproven across actual rooms. Static pose/orientation/DC unknown; no physical AoA/Doppler/3D claim
